source.description:
## PROBLEM
Mercury Docs needs versioned protected content and release inputs, but terminalbeta has no atomic publisher that guarantees complete objects and verified checksums before clients discover a version.

## SUCCESS
One command generates and publishes protected-docs/mcp/<version>/catalog.json, Markdown pages, search.json, releases/mcp_beta/<version>/manifest.json, and release assets, then updates current.json only after every uploaded object and checksum verifies.

## SCOPE
Define artifact schemas; generate docs catalog, pages, and search index; package release assets and sanitized source manifest data; calculate checksums; upload to private Supabase buckets; verify remote objects; reject duplicate versions; and atomically advance current.json after complete verification.

## NON_GOALS
Do not serve HTTP APIs, authorize users, sign download URLs, or embed Supabase service credentials in browser artifacts. Do not publish partial versions.

## CONSTRAINTS
This task supplies the private artifact contract consumed by platform-e9g. Use immutable version prefixes, deterministic outputs, idempotent verification, and a final pointer update as the only discovery step. Failed uploads leave the prior current.json intact.

## VALIDATION
Cover checksums, missing pages or assets, duplicate versions, partial upload failure, remote verification mismatch, interrupted pointer update, retry behavior, and successful publication. Confirm no secret, source-only path, or unsafe manifest field enters published client payloads.

## OUTPUT
A terminalbeta P1 publisher, schemas, generated artifact layout, private-bucket upload integration, atomic current.json update, rollback/cleanup guidance, and automated release-pipeline tests.

## Acceptance Criteria
All SUCCESS and VALIDATION conditions pass, remote checksums match, publication is atomic, failed uploads preserve the prior current.json, and no protected metadata leaks.
